summary: Scoped prototype audit of local Activity/Session/Presence rules only. Emulator negative/positive tests pass; production deployment and physical-device acceptance are pending. Existing unrelated rules were preserved.

findings.issue: RTDB ACL revocation follows an asynchronous Firestore role trigger. It is not atomic with the role change.
findings.recommendation: Deploy and monitor both ACL functions with the rules; verify promotion, ban, deletion and revocation in release acceptance. Never authorize admins writes from clients.

findings.issue: New counter deliberately excludes legacy online flags; old app versions without connections cannot contribute reliably.
findings.recommendation: Coordinate rollout and document temporary undercount. No data deletion or mass migration is included.

findings.issue: An authenticated client can manipulate its own telemetry (e.g. reported session duration or keeping its own connection record). Cross-UID writes and client admin escalation are denied.
findings.recommendation: Treat client telemetry as operational statistics, not billing/security attestation. Evaluate server validation or rate limiting separately if abuse appears.

findings.issue: No App Check integration or durable per-user rate limit. Authenticated clients can repeat the authorization callable; maxInstances limits concurrency, not total billing.
findings.recommendation: Monitor invocations and retries; stage App Check and abuse protection separately without breaking old apps.

validated: Activity and session validators shared across create/update, UID immutable and non-anonymous ownership enforced.
Server timestamp required for activity, session creation and end; duration nonnegative integer; display names and IDs bounded.
Only the owner can access their tiny connection; admins can read only the indexed connections query.
Admin ACL is server-only and derived from current Firestore role, not request data.
Legacy whole-node replacement is denied when new connections exist; one device cannot erase the other devices.
Guest Firestore writes remain denied; no public presence read.
RTDB keys bounded, connection values numeric server timestamps, unknown legacy fields rejected.
Emulator matrix covers Android/iOS provider tokens, foreign writes, role escalation, logout removal and transport disconnect.
Concurrent stale grant cannot overwrite a newer revocation: server readTime watermark, deny record retained, RTDB transaction.
Blocked admins denied analytics reads/deletes in Firestore and dashboard authorization in callable.
11 Firestore emulator tests and 4 RTDB/Functions integration tests; no production operations.
Callable success cache keyed by UID: ten minute monotonic TTL, shared in-flight request, invalidated at logout/permission denial; no automatic retry or polling.
Production Firestore non-Activity prefix matches local after newline normalization; prior chat changes already deployed.
Exact isolated candidate emulator tests pass; verified-admin-only rollback bridge separately tested.
Flutter analytics suite 28 passes, scoped analyzer clean.
productionBaseline: KNOWN: Firestore and RTDB rules read via GET; no production writes
